question.value: What is the nebular environment of HL Tau in JWST/NIRCam imaging, and what planet detection limits can be set inside and outside the disk?

evidence.quote: we use JWST NIRCam’s direct imaging mode in F187N, F200W, F405N, and F410M to perform high contrast observations of the circumstellar structures surrounding the protostar HL Tau.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.01234.S.
we compare our observations to the Moment 0 map by (cite: Yen2019).

provided.value: Direct imaging in F187N, F200W, F405N, F410M (program 1179), main data

evidence.quote: Our observations of HL Tau were taken on UT 2022-09-29 with JWST/NIRCam in direct imaging (non-coronagraphic) mode as part of GTO program 1179

provided.value: 2004 archival images (GO 9862) at 0.6 micron for comparison

evidence.quote: compare to 2004 HST observations from GO program 9862

what.value: ALMA HCO+ moment 0 map of HL Tau, provided by the author, used for comparison

evidence.quote: We would like to thank Yen Hsi-Wei for providing us with moment 0 ALMA $\textrm{HCO}^+$ data from (cite: Yen2019).

simulations_or_models_as_data.value: BEX and AMES-COND evolutionary tracks at 1 Myr used to convert flux limits to planet mass

evidence.quote: we used BEX (cite: Linder2019) evolutionary tracks for planets with $M_{\rm p} < 2 M_{\rm J}$ and AMES-COND models (cite: Chabrier2000) for more massive companions.

unstated_but_needed: ALMA HCO+ observational and imaging details (this paper only overlays Yen et al. 2019 moment 0 map)
Which ALMA project code is actually used (2011.0.01234.S in the paper vs 2011.0.00015.SV in the archive link)

evidence.quote: We reduced the data using the standard `jwst` pipeline (version 1.8.2 with crds version 11.16.15)

used_for.value: bad pixels, centering, PSF subtraction with PCA, synthetic planet injection

evidence.quote: This pipeline managed bad pixel correction, centering, point-spread-function (PSF) generation, PSF subtraction, and synthetic planet injection.
we generated a perfectly centered model PSF using `webbpsf` (cite: Perrin2014)

results_numeric.quantity: Deepest mass limit, F410M at 3.75 arcsec (525 AU)

evidence.quote: Our deepest limits are $\sim0.75~M_{\rm J}$ at 3.75$''$ (525 AU) separation in the F410M filter.

results_numeric.quantity: Mass sensitivity at 0.2-0.8 arcsec in disk region

evidence.quote: At these separations, we are sensitive to companions with $M_{\rm p}>8.6~M_{\rm J}$.

findings_qualitative.value: A SW spiral streamer seen in ALMA HCO+ is detected in scattered light at 4 micron; no planet candidates found.

evidence.quote: The position of our spiral aligns with the $\textrm{HCO}^+$ spiral, though the shape is somewhat different at IR wavelengths.

claims.hypothesis: Is the ALMA HCO+ spiral streamer detected in NIRCam scattered light?
claims.experiment: PSF-subtracted NIRCam images compared with Yen et al. HCO+ moment 0 map
claims.result: Part of the spiral is seen at 4 micron, mainly in F405N, aligned with HCO+ spiral
claims.finding: The IR feature traces dust scattering along the streamer

evidence.quote: The feature we detect traces a different component of the spiral than HCO$^+$ gas – likely light scattering off dust tracing the spiral shape.

claims.hypothesis: Can NIRCam detect protoplanets in HL Tau
claims.experiment: Synthetic planet injection with PSF subtraction
claims.result: No candidates; limits 5.2 MJ in disk region, 0.75 MJ outside

evidence.quote: We also do not detect any protoplanet candidates.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Roll-angle ADI rejected because of self-subtraction from the extended envelope; MWC 758 used as PSF reference.

evidence.quote: The stellar envelope is bright at near-IR wavelengths, and azimuthally extended, which causes severe self-subtraction between the two roll angles.

limitations_admitted.value: Over-subtraction from using MWC 758 as PSF reference hinders contrast at <1 arcsec.

evidence.quote: This over-subtraction likely hinders our contrast performance (especially at $<1\ensuremath{''}$ separation)

referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA is only used as a comparison map; no independent ALMA analysis
Mass limits assume 1 Myr age and no extinction
